record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

SCRIPT_DIR=`dirname $0`
SERVICE=nmtool_cm_agent

startType=$(cat $UNM_ROOT/unm2000install.ini | grep startType | awk -F '=' '{print $2}')
if [[ $startType -eq "1" ]]
then
	systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null
	if [ $? -eq 0 ]
		then
        echo "${SERVICE} is running"
	else
	   echo "start ${SERVICE}"
	   sudo systemctl start nmtool_cm_agent
	fi
else 
	pids=`ps -ef |grep $UNM_ROOT/tools/nmtools/unm_cm_agent |grep -v grep | awk '{print $2}'`
	#port=`netstat -tunlp | grep 10081 | grep -v grep | awk '{print $7}'`
	if [ "$pids" != "" ] 
	then
		echo "${SERVICE} is running"
	else
		source /etc/profile
		systemctl start nmtool_cm_agent
	fi
fi

record.rsp_body:
#!/bin/bash

systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null    
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
	systemctl stop nmtool_cm_agent.service
fi

systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null    
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
	systemctl stop nmtool_cm_service.service
fi
systemctl status ${SERVICE} &>/dev/null    
if [ $? -eq 0 ]
then
	systemctl stop nmtool_webservice.service
fi


SCRIPT_DIR="$( cd -- "$( dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" )" &> /dev/null && pwd )"


cd $SCRIPT_DIR

NMTOOLS_DIR=$SCRIPT_DIR/..
AGENT_DIR=$NMTOOLS_DIR/unm_cm_agent
SERVICE_DIR=$NMTOOLS_DIR/unm_cm_service
NGINX_DIR=$SERVICE_DIR/thirdparty/nginx

#停止cmagent服务
echo 停止cmagent服务
cd $AGENT_DIR/bin
#chmod 750 stop_nmtool_agent.sh
sh stop_nmtool_agent.sh

#停止cmservice服务
echo 停止cmservice服务
cd $SERVICE_DIR/bin
#chmod 750 stop_nmtool_service.sh
sh stop_nmtool_service.sh

#停止nginx
echo 停止nginx
cd $NGINX_DIR/bin
#chmod 750 stop_nmtool_webservice.sh
sh stop_nmtool_webservice.sh

record.rule_name: 疑似访问/下载脚本文件
record.rsp_body:
@echo off

cd /d %~dp0
cd ..
set WEB_HOME=%cd%

set MYSQL_HOME=%WEB_HOME%/thirdparty/mysql
cd %MYSQL_HOME%/bin

if not exist my.ini (
    echo create msql initialize file...
    (
    echo [mysql]
    echo default-character-set=utf8mb4
    echo [mysqld]
    echo port = 3306
    echo basedir= %MYSQL_HOME%/
    echo datadir= %MYSQL_HOME%/data
    echo max_connections=50
    echo character-set-server=utf8
    echo default-storage-engine=INNODB
    echo default_authentication_plugin=mysql_native_password
    ) > my.ini
    echo install mysql...
    cd %MYSQL_HOME%/
    mkdir data
    cd %MYSQL_HOME%/bin
    mysqld --initialize-insecure --user=root
    mysqld --install

    echo start mysql server...
    net start mysql

    echo set pwd for root...
    set username=root
    set pwd=vislecaina
    mysql -uroot -e "alter user '%username%'@'localhost' identified by '%pwd%';"

    echo load database data...
    mysql -uroot -p%pwd% < %WEB_HOME%/service/cable-health-monitor/db/cablehealthdb.sql"

    mysql -uroot -p%pwd% < %WEB_HOME%/service/cable-health-monitor/db/t_operationinfo_sql.sql"

    mysql -uroot -p%pwd% < %WEB_HOME%/service/cable-health-monitor/db/t_role_operation_sql.sql"

) else (
    echo start mysql server...
    net start mysql
)

cd %WEB_HOME% in
pause
